mapper.select: SELECT id, card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, package, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, package, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time FROM phone_card WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_card (card_number, agent_id, agent_name, phone_number, realname_id, realname_name, department, package, card_status, card_type, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{cardNumber}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{realnameId}, #{realnameName}, #{department}, #{package_}, #{cardStatus}, #{cardType}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
